items.item_text: Competency certification of I.V admixture preparation and compounding is required of the Pharmacy Tech II upon hire or within thirty (30) days of hire date. This requirement may be satisfied by submission of competency certification for I.V. admixture preparation and compounding from a qualified institution or successful completion of I.V admixture preparation and compounding assessment through observation and assessment by department management within thirty (30) days of hire

Six (6) months of previous hospital pharmacy experience

As our Pharmacy Technician II, you will play a crucial role in preparing and distributing all medication orders (excluding I.V. Chemotherapy admixtures) according to hospital policies, standard practices of the profession and State and Federal laws and regulations.

Every day, you will utilize your knowledge and experience to precisely fill medication orders and accurately maintain records. You will work tactfully and effectively with team members, the patient and their family, and the public.
To be sucessful in this role, you will pay strong attention to detail and follow both oral and written directions.
Registered State Board of Pharmacy Technician (CT PHRMTEC)
